data.one_liner: Provides Nhost authentication state to your Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Provides Nhost authentication state to your Flutter application, making it easy to set up protected resources and react to sign-ins and sign-outs.
use_when: You are using Nhost as the backend for your Flutter application.
You need to handle user authentication state and protected resources.
avoid_when: You are using Firebase or another non-Nhost backend for authentication.
You do not need Nhost-specific auth state management.
strengths: Integrates smoothly with Nhost backend services.
Simplifies reaction to sign-in and sign-out events.
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Nhost ecosystem.
Limited documentation and examples provided in the README.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are using Firebase instead of Nhost for your backend authentication.
